messages: Alex (acme-dev): Hey team, hitting 403 when our Private collector tries to upload debug bundle to S3 via presigned URL. Customer hit a production error earlier and we need the bundle for redaction check. Request-id from collector logs: req_9f3b2a. Throwing Authorization header missing / SignatureDoesNotMatch in the upload step. Maria (Support): Sorry you're blocked — can you paste the minimal curl you used to upload? also attach the collector log excerpt around req_9f3b2a. :pray: If presign failed we'll want the signed-manifest and the presigned URL (safe to redact the URL host if sensitive). Alex (acme-dev): Here's the curl we ran (redacted host): ``` curl -X PUT "https://redacted-presign.s3.amazonaws.com/bundle.tgz?X-Amz-Signature=..." \ -H "Content-Type: application/octet-stream" \ --data-binary @debug-bundle.tgz -v ``` and log snippet: ``` 2026-03-15T18:02:12Z collector[1]: req=req_9f3b2a presign_status=200 presign_body="{\"url\":\"https://redacted-presign.s3.amazonaws.com/..\",\"fields\":{}}" 2026-03-15T18:02:13Z collector[1]: req=req_9f3b2a upload_start 2026-03-15T18:02:13Z collector[1]: req=req_9f3b2a upload_error code=403 body="\n\n SignatureDoesNotMatch\n The request signature we calculated does not match the signature you provided.\n" ``` Maria (Support): Looks like the presign step returned an object with `fields` empty — are you using form POST presigns or URL PUT presigns? The curl above is a PUT-style presign. If your collector tries a multipart/form-data POST but you used a PUT presign that would cause mismatch. What collector version are you running? Alex (acme-dev): Collector v1.8.2 (docker image sha256:abc123). Our config is the default redaction enabled. We didn't change upload mode. The collector debug command used was `collector collect --out debug-bundle.tgz --redact` per docs. Priya (Oncall): Can you run `collector --version` and `collector generate-debug-bundle --diagnose` and paste output? Also include `bundlebot` report if available (we log signed-manifest checks). Alex (acme-dev): Ran diagnose. Output: ``` collector version: 1.8.2 debug: redact=true upload.mode: auto upload.presign.type: POST presign.response: {"url":"https://redacted-presign.s3.amazonaws.com/","fields":{}} signed_manifest.exists: true signed_manifest.checksum: 7b1f2c3d ``` Maria (Support): Aha — presign.type is POST but your curl is PUT. The collector probably picked POST but the presign response had empty fields which is suspicious (should contain AWS policy/form fields). Two likely causes: 1) presign generator returned PUT presign and collector mis-detected, or 2) a proxy rewrote/removed the fields. Can you upload the full presign response JSON (redact tokens) and also run a quick repro where collector logs the exact HTTP method and form payload during upload? Alex (acme-dev): Attached presign response (redacted tokens). We ran a verbose collector upload and it shows `POST /` with empty form body. The uploader sets `Content-Type: multipart/form-data` but fields is empty. Kevin (Eng-Infra): Jumping in — on our side presign generation for private deployments signs either POST (form) or PUT (url) depending on the storage adapter. The empty `fields` implies the presign service returned a POST envelope but failed to include form fields due to a signing-layer bug when KMS key rotation happened recently. Can you share the signed-manifest content (base64) and the cloud provider request-id for the presign call so we can correlate? Alex (acme-dev): Signed-manifest (base64) = "eyJidW5kbGVfaWQiOiI..." and presign provider request id: aws_req_01234abcd. Maria (Support): Thanks. One more ask: can you reproduce the upload with `curl` using the exact presign JSON by simulating the POST form? Example repro we want you to try (replace fields with those returned): ``` curl -v -X POST "https://redacted-presign.s3.amazonaws.com/" \ -F "key=path/to/bundle.tgz" \ -F "policy=..." \ -F "x-amz-signature=..." \ -F "file=@debug-bundle.tgz" ``` If that succeeds it proves the presign and upload are compatible. If it fails with 403, capture full response. Alex (acme-dev): Tried that exact POST form with fields present (copied from presign body) — got 403 with the same SignatureDoesNotMatch. Response includes header `x-amz-request-id: 8F9ABCD12345` and server `AmazonS3`. Priya (Oncall): Ok, since this is Private and KMS is involved we need Eng-Infra to verify the signing key. Kevin — can you check the presign service logs for aws_req_01234abcd and confirm the policy computed and canonical request? Also, did we rotate the signing key within the last 48h for that customer tenant? Kevin (Eng-Infra): Looking now. We did a scheduled rotation 36 hours ago for the tenant's signing key — intended to be backward compatible but I see an edge case: our presign layer omits `x-amz-security-token` when the session token is empty which can change the canonical string for STS-based creds. If collector included a session token header but the form didn't, signature mismatch occurs. We'll search logs for the exact canonical string for aws_req_01234abcd. bundlebot: Signed-manifest check: manifest checksum 7b1f2c3d matches upload manifest. Redaction-scan: found 2 potential PII matches (emails) — will redact on bundle generation. Maria (Support): Short-term mitigation: while we fix signing, you can switch collector to SFTP fallback or use the private-console to upload the bundle manually (console -> debug -> upload). For reproducibility please run the collector with `--upload-mode sftp` and attempt upload; that avoids presign path. If you need the automatic flow, we can patch presign service. Alex (acme-dev): SFTP fallback worked and bundle uploaded. We still need native flow working for automation. Any ETA on patch? Kevin (Eng-Infra): I'm drafting a hotfix to include empty `x-amz-security-token` explicitly in the presign fields when session credentials are used. I'll open PR and can backport to the 1.2.3 hotfix branch. ETA ~4 hours for rollout to the Private tenant region; will update here. Priya (Oncall): Once patch is live please trigger a re-presign for the original request id or ask the collector to regenerate the presign (new signed-manifest). Maria — can you keep the customer updated and capture the repro steps we ran so we can close the escal? Also add the signed-manifest + aws_req ids to the ticket. Maria (Support): On it — I'll email the account team and confirm SFTP workaround is acceptable for now. Alex, thanks for staying on this and for providing the logs + curl tries — that massively sped troubleshooting. :+1: Alex (acme-dev): Thanks everyone, will stand by for the patch and will re-test once you say go.
